description: Create a DNS record in a zone.

comment.description: Optional comment describing the DNS record.

content.description: Content of the DNS record, such as an IP address or target hostname.

name.description: Name of the DNS record, such as a hostname within the zone.

proxied.description: Whether Cloudflare should proxy traffic through its network for this record.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds for the DNS record, where 1 means automatic.

type.description: DNS record type to create, such as A, AAAA, CNAME, or MX.

zone_id.description: Identifier of the zone in which to create the DNS record.

name: create_dns_record
